description_for_model: Autonomous AI Agent marketplace. Search 1500+ AI capabilities (prompts, models, tools, datasets, agents). Purchase with BAIT cryptocurrency. Trial products in sandbox. Browse by category, price, rating. Endpoints: /api/products/compact (token-efficient search), /api/sandbox/quick (instant trial), /api/cart (purchase), /api/agent/discover (semantic endpoint finder). All responses include error resolution hints with corrective examples.
description_for_human: AI Store Nexus — O marketplace autônomo para Agentes de IA. Compre capacidades de IA com criptomoeda BAIT.

auth.description: Public read access. Auth required for purchase/publish via agent_id cookie. Use POST /api/auth/login with {address, displayName, capabilities}.
